fields.mechanism: Driving fluid flow through a conduit by applying a controlled vacuum pressure gradient across the lumen, governed by Darcy's law.
fields.intervention: Integrate a regulated vacuum source at the proximal or distal terminus of the multi-lumen medical tubing to establish a sustained negative pressure gradient along the internal lumens, actively driving fluid flow rather than relying exclusively on upstream positive pressure that is susceptible to friction-induced loss.
fields.expected_effect: The applied vacuum pressure gradient compensates for frictional pressure loss along the tubing length, maintaining target flow rates without requiring an increase in upstream driving pressure, while preserving the existing wall geometry to maintain kink resistance and lumen patency.
fields.falsification_test: Measure the differential pressure between the inlet and outlet of the multi-lumen tubing under constant flow conditions with and without the applied terminal vacuum; if the measured pressure drop across the tubing length does not decrease when the vacuum gradient is applied, the mechanism fails to address the failure.
fields.mechanism_source_span: This review reframes dermal ISF sampling as a pressure gradient engineering problem using Darcy's law. We examine how vacuum-assisted microneedle platforms can effectively drive ISF through the dermal extracellular matrix in a minimally invasive manner.

fields.mechanism: Passive pressure gradient driven fluid transport through a porous matrix governed by Darcy's law, with the active vacuum element removed to rely solely on structural flow pathways.
fields.intervention: Remove any active suction or pressurization elements and instead engineer the inner walls of the multi-lumen tubing as a micropore-based structural matrix that passively equalizes pressure gradients between adjacent lumens via Darcy flow, maintaining overall lumen patency and kink resistance without requiring hollow active channels.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in localized pressure loss along the tubing length by allowing passive inter-lumen pressure equilibration through the porous wall structure, preserving kink resistance and lumen patency without an active driving source.
fields.falsification_test: Measure the pressure drop across a 1-meter length of the modified micropore-matrix multi-lumen tubing at a constant flow rate; if the pressure drop is not statistically lower than standard solid-wall multi-lumen tubing while passing standard kink-resistance mandrel tests, the mechanism fails.

fields.mechanism: Application of a vacuum to establish a controlled pressure gradient that drives fluid flow through a conduit according to Darcy's law.
fields.intervention: Integrate a passive vacuum chamber or regulated negative-pressure reservoir at the proximal end of the multi-lumen tubing to apply a compensating negative pressure gradient across the lumen length, driving flow without requiring an increase in upstream positive pressure or altering the tube geometry.
fields.expected_effect: Reduced net pressure loss across the tubing during operation while maintaining the original wall thickness and cross-sectional geometry required for kink resistance and lumen patency.
fields.falsification_test: Measure the pressure differential between inlet and outlet of the multi-lumen tubing under constant volumetric flow rate with and without the applied proximal vacuum; failure is indicated if the pressure differential does not decrease or if the tubing collapses under the applied vacuum.

fields.mechanism: Vacuum-assisted pressure gradient driving fluid flow through internal lumens, combining fluidic pressure differential with structural retention of hollow conduits.
fields.intervention: Integrate a low-level vacuum source at the distal outlet of the multi-lumen medical tubing to apply a controlled negative pressure gradient through the internal lumens, supplementing proximal positive-pressure drive and reducing the required inlet pressure while the retained hollow lumen walls maintain kink resistance and patency.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in net positive inlet pressure required to achieve target flow rates, decreasing overall pressure loss across the tubing length without increasing wall collapse risk or compromising kink resistance.
fields.falsification_test: Measure steady-state pressure drop across a 1-meter length of multi-lumen tubing at a fixed flow rate with and without a -50 mmHg distal vacuum assist; if pressure loss does not decrease by at least 10 percent or if lumen cross-sectional area measured via optical coherence tomography decreases under vacuum, the intervention fails.
fields.mechanism_source_span: The hollow microneedle approach retains the microneedles in the skin and applies vacuum through internal lumens, allowing integration of the vacuum source, microneedles, and biosensors into a single wearable platform for in situ biomarker detection.

fields.mechanism: Application of a controlled vacuum (negative pressure) to drive fluid flow through a conduit without requiring structural changes that reduce the internal cross-sectional area, thereby maintaining patency while overcoming flow resistance.
fields.intervention: Integrate a regulated vacuum source at the proximal or distal end of the multi-lumen medical tubing to establish a negative pressure gradient across the lumens, actively driving fluid flow to compensate for frictional pressure loss without adding internal stents, ribs, or stiffeners that would compromise lumen patency or kink resistance.
fields.expected_effect: The applied vacuum gradient offsets the frictional pressure drop along the tubing length, restoring net flow delivery pressure while the unmodified tube wall geometry preserves original kink resistance and full lumen patency.
fields.falsification_test: Measure the pressure-flow curve of the multi-lumen tubing with and without the applied vacuum assist; if the vacuum-assisted configuration does not achieve equal or greater flow rate at the same inlet pressure compared to the baseline, or if applying the vacuum causes measurable lumen collapse reducing patency by more than 5 percent, the intervention is falsified.
